# ConnectionStatus

Shows whether the engine is live and which sources are sending data right now.

`CLR.ConnectionStatus` · Live state

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.ConnectionStatus status={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.ConnectionStatus" status="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ConnectionStatusProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` * | `'live' \| 'reconnecting' \| 'offline'` |  |
| `sources` | `Partial<Record<SourceKind, boolean>>` | Sources currently sending. Unlisted sources render as not connected. |
| `lastSeenSeconds` | `number` | Seconds since the last tick, shown when reconnecting or offline. |
